observations.title: Platform role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Wraps platform-specific Forge and Fabric services through an Architectury-based layer; it is developer infrastructure rather than an unrestricted loader-compatibility bridge.
conditions: Exact installed 1.4.2 Forge metadata and SHA-256 were inspected.
VanillaBackport 1.2.2 requires Platform 1.4 or newer. Rotten Creatures accepts Platform 1.2.4 or newer.
The dedicated server must complete Forge loading before this dependency correction is treated as delivered.
observations.review_note: The prior 1.3.4 artifact caused Forge pre-loading to fail because VanillaBackport 1.2.2 declares Platform [1.4,). Official Forge 1.20.1 release 1.4.2 is the current compatible replacement. Server completion remains a separate runtime check.
